content: Resume-as-image/flat-picture PDFs have no underlying text layer, so ATS systems and screen readers parse nothing - effectively a blank page to any automated system. This is both an accessibility failure (assistive tech can't read it) and an ATS-searchability failure (keyword matching fails, application may be auto-rejected). Accessible/ATS-friendly PDFs need real extractable text, tags, and correct reading order - exporting from a word processor keeps this; a flattened screenshot/image does not.
